answer: The lantern register is checked at draw time, tide lists the eligible set, and ocean seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 85 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 85 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. A 116 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
